name: Dragonborn
summary: Draconic folk with a breath weapon and the resistance of their ancestry.
description: Dragonborn carry the ancestry of dragons. They choose a draconic ancestry that sets the damage type of their breath weapon and their resistance.

properties.traits: Draconic Ancestry, Breath Weapon, Damage Resistance, Darkvision, Draconic Flight

name: Dwarf
summary: Bold and hardy, dwarves are skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone.
description: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal. They are tough, see well in the dark, and have a knack for stonework.

properties.traits: Darkvision (120 ft.), Dwarven Resilience, Dwarven Toughness, Stonecunning

name: Elf
summary: A slender, graceful people with a deep connection to magic and nature.
description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace. Each belongs to a lineage that grants a particular magical gift, and all share keen senses and a trance in place of sleep.

properties.traits: Darkvision, Elven Lineage, Fey Ancestry, Keen Senses, Trance

name: Gnome
summary: Small, curious folk whose lineage grants either forest or tinkering magic.
description: Gnomes are small, inquisitive people. Their lineage gives them a magical gift suited to the forest or to clever tinkering, and a natural wariness of magic used against them.

name: Goliath
summary: Towering folk descended from giants, strong and hardy in mountain country.
description: Goliaths are tall and powerfully built. Each carries a boon from a type of giant in their ancestry and can briefly grow larger.

properties.traits: Giant Ancestry, Large Form, Powerful Build

name: Halfling
summary: Small, brave, and lucky wanderers who slip easily out of danger.
description: Halflings are small folk known for courage, nimble movement, and good fortune. They can slip past larger creatures and shrug off fear.

properties.traits: Brave, Halfling Nimbleness, Luck, Naturally Stealthy

name: Human
summary: The most adaptable and ambitious people among the common species.
description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common species. They are resourceful, skilled, and versatile, and they take an extra feat of their choice.

name: Orc
summary: Tireless, powerful folk who surge with energy in a fight.
description: Orcs are powerful and enduring. They see well in the dark, can dash forward with a burst of adrenaline, and refuse to fall at the edge of death.

properties.traits: Adrenaline Rush, Darkvision (120 ft.), Relentless Endurance

name: Tiefling
summary: Heirs of the Lower Planes, marked by fiendish magic.
description: Tieflings carry a fiendish legacy that grants resistance and innate spells according to their ancestry, and an unsettling presence.
